owner: CGX semantic definitions as imported by PrintSpace; source owner must approve before runtime or public release
public_label: Hyper-Tech — technology extensions raising verified awareness/capability on existing machines

planes.FileSpace: Original design, CAD, datasheets, semantic CGX object/family/part references, capability manifest and legally scoped permissions
planes.DataSpace: Measurements, actual device state, changes, DBR ancestry, import/export consent, uncertainty and history
planes.PrintSpace: Fabrication, physical upgrade, installed hardware provenance and acceptance evidence, independent C0 hardware guards
planes.WorkSpace: Physical zone limits, user intent, shared actors, safety permissions, proposed job, workflow ownership and audit
planes.CCC_CYC: Optional signed/provenance-aware package and authorised community publication/download; NOT an automatic market or an active entitlement claim

security_invariants: Offline first if configured; no wireless or internet imposed
CGX local identity does not grant remote permissions
USB device must not autorun or silently use privileged host control
Human/owner approval and hardware E-stop prevail over optional intelligence
Data minimization and private home/workspace boundaries
No hidden camera/audio scanning or network discovery
Passive child may have global type record but not mandatory independent node
Safety-critical appliances retain OEM interlocks and electrical/certified repair routes
